standfirst: The smallest of the three closterovirid modules, and the one carrying a thaumatin-like protein that the others do not. Thirty-one features: seven core, the coordinate-built ORF1a, the transcript-edited RdRp and 22 lineage-specific accessories.

modules.Velarivirus: Only POLY, RDRP, CP and HSP70 are essential here. CPm, HSP90 and the thaumatin-like protein are carried by part of the genus and deliberately omit copy_num.

gaps: 44.1% of features reached a collection, the lowest of the eight modules on this page series. That is worth knowing rather than hiding: the genus is sparsely and inconsistently annotated in BV-BRC.
